manifest.name: Actions
manifest.description: User-defined applications, explicit scripts and URLs with device-local review.
ui.heading: Actions
ui.title: Name
ui.target: Program, absolute script path or URL
ui.argsHint: Separate arguments with spaces. Put several words in quotes: connect "my alias". Symbols such as $ and * are passed literally.
ui.empty: No actions yet. Add a program, script or link.
ui.outputLimited: Output limit reached. Process stopped. Output is truncated.
ui.program_not_found: Program not found on this device. Edit its path or install it.
ui.directory_not_found: Working directory does not exist on this device.
ui.approval_required: This definition needs a new device review. Run it again to review.
ui.invalid_arguments: Close the argument quotes. Use "two words" for an argument containing spaces.
ui.invalid_script: Specify an interpreter and an absolute script path.
ui.invalid_url: Enter a complete http:// or https:// URL without embedded credentials.
ui.invalid_action: Check the name, program and launch mode.
ui.invalid_scope: This Deal is unavailable. Reopen it.
ui.start_failed: Could not launch the program. Check its permissions, script path and working directory.
ui.action_not_found: The action has changed or was deleted. Reload this view.
ui.operation_failed: Could not complete the operation. Check plugin permissions and try again.
ui.invalid_directory: Use an absolute working directory path.
ui.absolute_executable_required: Use an executable name on PATH or an absolute program path.
ui.invalid_limits: The time or output limit is invalid.
ui.invalid_request: The launch request is invalid or too large. Reduce the arguments and try again.
ui.open_failed: The system could not open this link. Check the default browser.
ui.process_control_unavailable: The system could not establish process cancellation. Launch was refused.
ui.too_many_processes: Too many commands are running. Stop one or wait for completion.
ui.approval_store_unavailable: Device permissions cannot be saved or read. Check access to the application configuration folder.
ui.approval_store_invalid: The device permission file is damaged. Restore it or remove process-approvals.json from the application settings to review actions again.
ui.review_failed: The native confirmation could not be opened. Try again.
ui.review_expired: The application state changed during review. Run the action again to review it.
